niche: connected TV and streaming advertising agency
prompt_text: What is the best connected TV advertising agency?
answer_verbatim:
There’s no single “best” connected TV (CTV) advertising agency — the right one depends on your goals, budget, target audience, creative needs, measurement requirements, and whether you want a full-service partner or a specialist. To help you choose quickly, here’s a practical approach and a short list of reputable options by type.

Quick questions so I can recommend specific agencies:
- What’s your goal? (brand awareness, direct response, ROAS, app installs, etc.)
- Monthly/total budget range for CTV?
- Geography and audiences (US only, global, demos, markets)?
- Need creative production for 30–60s CTV spots or just media buying?
- Do you require cross-channel integration (TV + digital) or CTV-only?
- Preference: holding-company scale vs. boutique specialist vs. platform/DSP?

How to pick the “best” agency for you
- Platform access and partnerships (Roku, Hulu, Samsung, FAST channels)
- Programmatic buying capability vs. direct buys
- Creative expertise for TV-format creatives and dynamic/ad personalization
- Measurement & attribution (incrementality, third-party verification)
- Data and audience targeting (first/second-party data activation)
- Reporting transparency and frequency capping/fraud prevention
- Case studies in your industry and clear KPI alignment
- Pricing model and minimums (some CTV specialists have higher minimum spends)

Reputable agencies and platforms to consider
- Large holding-group/full-service (good for integrated cross-channel campaigns and scale)
  - GroupM (Wavemaker, Mindshare)
  - Omnicom (OMD, PHD)
  - Publicis (Spark Foundry, Zenith)
  - Dentsu (Carat)
  - IPG (Initiative, UM)

- CTV-specialists and ad-technology leaders (strong programmatic, measurement, or creative for CTV)
  - The Trade Desk (DSP — widely used by agencies; excellent programmatic reach)
  - Innovid (creative + measurement for connected TV)
  - Simulmedia (TV/CTV analytics and programmatic planning)
  - Tremor (Tremor Video; CTV buys and programmatic video)
  - Amobee (cross-screen platform with CTV capabilities)
  - Roku OneView (platform-direct buys on Roku)
  - FreeWheel (Comcast) / Magnite / Xandr (platform inventory/SSP and tech partners)

- Boutique/performance-focused firms (often better for mid-market brands wanting fast, measurable results)
  - Tinuiti (digital & CTV performance)
  - Smaller local/boutique CTV agencies — good if you want hands-on service or niche industry experience

Next steps I can do for you
- Recommend 2–3 agencies tailored to your answers to the questions above
- Draft an RFP checklist and example KPIs to send to agencies
- Compare 2 agencies side-by-side based on capability, pricing, and case studies

Tell me your objectives, budget, and market and I’ll recommend the best match.
